tex_content.html:
Proposition
Source: topping:page-0087 ↗ topping-ch8-compatible-arguments 1. ch8:1.2\group perelman-w-entropy

The map $(g,f,\tau )\mapsto (\tau ^{-1}g,f,1)$ preserves compatibility and \[ \mathcal W(g,f,\tau )=\mathcal W(\tau ^{-1}g,f,1). \]

On $\mathbb R^n$, let \[ d\mu =(2\pi )^{-n/2}e^{-|x|^2/2}\, dx, \qquad \int _{\mathbb R^n}d\mu =1. \]
